links.outcome: Readability level of AI-generated exercise recommendations (Flesch-Kincaid grade, reading ease)
links.effect: Average readability was college level (mean 13.7, SD 1.7), with average Flesch reading ease score of 31.1 (SD 7.7).
links.quote: Average readability level of AI-generated exercise recommendations was at the college level (mean 13.7, SD 1.7), with an average Flesch reading ease score of 31.1 (SD 7.7).

links.outcome: Reading level of AI-generated patient-directed exercise materials
links.effect: College-level readability (mean grade 13.7, SD 1.7); Flesch reading ease 31.1 (SD 7.7).

links.outcome: Comprehensiveness and factual accuracy of AI exercise recommendations versus gold-standard guidelines
links.effect: Recommendations were 41.2% (107/260) comprehensive and 90.7% (146/161) accurate; most inaccuracy (8/15, 53%) related to preparticipation medical clearance.
links.quote: AI-generated exercise recommendations were 41.2% (107/260) comprehensive and 90.7% (146/161) accurate, with the majority (8/15, 53%) of inaccuracy related to the need for exercise preparticipation medical clearance.

links.outcome: Bias or discrimination in AI-generated content for specific populations
links.effect: Qualitative themes included potential bias and direct discrimination against certain age-based populations and individuals with disabilities.
links.quote: Several recurring themes and observations of AI-generated output included concern for liability and safety, preference for aerobic exercise, and potential bias and direct discrimination against certain age-based populations and individuals with disabilities.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of an AI chatbot's exercise recommendations for 26 clinical populations, evaluating accuracy, comprehensiveness, and readability, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
